children: South Korea's consumer prices rose 2.9% in September from a year earlier, government data showed on Friday, in line with market expectations.
That was weaker than the 3.1% rise in August and matches a 2.9% increase forecast in a Reuters poll of economists.
The consumer price index rose 0.3% on a monthly basis, after gaining 0.2% in the previous month, according to the Ministry of Data and Statistics.
